headline: WATCH seats four more arcades — BeeZee, TidyBot, PickRush and GardenGuard now play themselves
lede: Batch 8 of the WATCH rollout landed: four titles whose attract demos already flew their own proven autopilot got the Y key in the play tick, re-deciding from live state every tick. Press Y, watch the game beat itself, touch anything to take over. 41 of 80 arcade titles now wear the seat.

notes.text: Resumed a corpse: batch 8 was built, gated and PR'd by a session that died waiting on the nightly freeze. This session re-proved every gate fresh on current main (watchcheck 404/404, phone 300/300, pill 139/139, attract 694/0) and merged.

BeeZee's prover signal had to change: wind drifts an idle bee across flowers and contact-pollinates them, so movement/nectar alone are not prover-only — the watch gate counts consumed thrust instead, mutant-proved.
PickRush seats only the human's own seat under watch; seat-2 partner keys never unseat the watcher (SmashTV/Archery precedent).

The warden's target (#1759, GRAVEL YARD delivery pin) turned out already shipped as #1763 — stale routing noted; the ladder took the corpse rung instead. #1637 stays open with a batch-9 plan: the attract-brain family is exhausted, the solver/hash family is next.
